# buf.generate runs a local protoc-gen-go plugin from buf.gen.yaml, reruns
# when a source, the template, or a generated file changes, and --clean
# removes the plugin's output directory.
[!exec:buf] skip
[!exec:protoc-gen-go] skip

bit
stdout 'gen ▶ buf generate'
stdout 'gen ✔ ok'
grep 'package v1' gen/acme/v1/user.pb.go

bit
stdout 'gen · no changes'

cp user.proto.changed proto/acme/v1/user.proto
bit
stdout '''proto/acme/v1/user\.proto'' changed'
grep 'GetEmail' gen/acme/v1/user.pb.go

rm gen/acme/v1/user.pb.go
bit
stdout '''gen/acme/v1/user\.pb\.go'' \(removed\) changed'
exists gen/acme/v1/user.pb.go

# The output the template no longer names is removed by the run.
cp buf.gen.yaml.out buf.gen.yaml
bit
stdout 'gen ▶ buf generate \(no longer generates ''gen''\)'
! stdout '\(removed\)'
exists out/acme/v1/user.pb.go
! exists gen

bit
stdout 'gen · no changes'

bit --clean
stdout 'gen ▶ rm -rf out'
! exists out
exists proto/acme/v1/user.proto

-- BUILD.bit --
gen = buf.generate {}
-- buf.yaml --
version: v2
modules:
  - path: proto
-- buf.gen.yaml --
version: v2
plugins:
  - local: protoc-gen-go
    out: gen
    opt: paths=source_relative
-- buf.gen.yaml.out --
version: v2
plugins:
  - local: protoc-gen-go
    out: out
    opt: paths=source_relative
-- proto/acme/v1/user.proto --
syntax = "proto3";

package acme.v1;

option go_package = "example.com/acme/v1";

message User {
  string name = 1;
}
-- user.proto.changed --
syntax = "proto3";

package acme.v1;

option go_package = "example.com/acme/v1";

message User {
  string name = 1;
  string email = 2;
}
